init.title: Whatsminer Options: Connection & PID Core
init.description: Configure connection settings, power bounds, target temperature, and PID gains. The PID controller is always on; these settings define the power range it may command and how hard it pushes.

data_description.password: The API password for the miner
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the miner for updates (10-300 seconds)
data_description.power_min: Lowest power limit the PID controller may command
data_description.power_max: Highest power limit the PID controller may command
data_description.pid_target_temp: Target temperature for the PID controller (°F)
data_description.pid_kp: Proportional gain - controls response to current error

safety.title: Whatsminer Options: Thermal Safety
safety.description: Configure chip and supply temperature safety caps and lockout thresholds.

data_description.chip_temp_safety_cap: Hard override clamps power to minimum when chip temp exceeds this threshold
data_description.pid_supply_temp_safety_cap: Soft cap - forces power_min when supply temp exceeds this threshold. Also one of the demand-shutoff stop triggers when every thermostat is idle
data_description.pid_supply_temp_lockout: Hard lockout - stops mining when supply temp exceeds this threshold. Latched across restarts until Reset Supply Lockout is pressed with the supply below the safety cap

demand.title: Whatsminer Options: Demand, Shutoff & Freeze Guard
demand.description: Choose the thermostats that tell the controller when heat is wanted, decide whether the miner may be powered off entirely when none of them is calling, and protect the miner's outdoor coolant loop from freezing while it is stopped.

data.pid_demand_shutoff_outdoor_min: Shutoff: Warm Enough Outside (°F, 24 h mean)

data_description.pid_demand_entities: Climate entities to monitor for heating demand. When all are idle, power is clamped to minimum and, when demand shutoff is active, the miner is powered off. Leave empty to disable demand handling.
data_description.pid_demand_shutoff_mode: off = never power the miner off for lack of demand. observe = run the full shutoff logic and publish what it would do (in the shutoff sensors) without sending any command to the miner; use this to check the timing before trusting it. active = actually power the miner off when every thermostat is idle and power it back on when heat is wanted again.
data_description.pid_demand_shutoff_outdoor_min: Only consider powering off for lack of demand when the outdoor temperature, averaged over a centred 24 hour window, is at or above this. Below it, minimum power is treated as useful heat and the miner stays on. Default 58°F.
data_description.pid_demand_shutoff_hysteresis: How far the 24 hour outdoor mean must fall below the threshold above before the warm-weather shutoff disarms again. Stops the gate from flapping when the mean hovers near the line.
data_description.pid_demand_shutoff_idle_dwell_min: How long every thermostat must stay idle, with warm weather confirmed, before the miner is powered off. A short idle gap between heating calls will not trigger a stop.
data_description.pid_demand_shutoff_min_off_min: Once stopped, do not power the miner back on for at least this long unless the freeze guard forces a resume. Avoids rapid off/on cycling. 0 disables.
data_description.pid_demand_shutoff_min_on_min: Once resumed, do not power the miner off again for at least this long. The supply-overheat stop ignores this. 0 disables.
data_description.pid_demand_shutoff_supply_stop: Also power the miner off when every thermostat is idle and the supply temperature sits at or above the soft safety cap, regardless of outdoor temperature. With no flow in the loop, minimum power alone can drift the supply up to the lockout latch.
data_description.pid_demand_shutoff_supply_dwell_min: How long the supply must stay at or above the soft cap, with every thermostat idle, before the supply-overheat stop fires.
data_description.pid_demand_shutoff_unknown_grace_min: If a thermostat becomes unavailable or stops reporting, keep treating it as calling for heat for this long before ignoring it. Keeps a flaky thermostat from being read as satisfied. 0 disables.
data_description.pid_demand_shutoff_cold_room_delta: A room this far (°F) or more below its thermostat setpoint counts as calling for heat even if the thermostat reports idle. Guards against a stop while a zone is still cold.
data_description.freeze_guard_sensor: Optional. Temperature sensor on the miner's outdoor coolant loop (or outdoor air near it). When this reads at or below the freeze threshold, every stop is blocked and a stopped miner is resumed immediately. When no sensor is set, the controller falls back to the weather entity's current temperature and its forecast minimum over the forecast horizon below.
data_description.freeze_guard_threshold: Temperature (°F) at or below which the freeze guard engages: no stop is allowed and a stopped miner is powered back on. The 40°F default assumes plain water coolant; lower it if the loop holds glycol.
data_description.freeze_guard_forecast_hours: How many hours ahead to scan the weather forecast for the minimum temperature when no freeze guard sensor is set. A forecast minimum at or below the threshold engages the guard before the cold arrives.

feedforward.title: Whatsminer Options: Feedforward & Compensation
feedforward.description: Configure the PID process-variable sensor, outdoor temperature feedforward, and weather forecast blending. The outdoor-reset curve below drives power if the process-variable sensor becomes unavailable.

data_description.external_temp_sensor: Temperature sensor used as the PID process variable (required; normally the supply probe)
data_description.pid_outdoor_temp_sensor: Optional. Outdoor temperature for feedforward; the weather entity's temperature is used when this is empty or unavailable
data_description.pid_ke: Feedforward watts per °F of (setpoint − outdoor temperature); 0 disables
data_description.pid_weather_entity: Optional. Supplies hourly forecasts for blending, current outdoor temperature when no outdoor sensor is set, and the freeze guard fallback when no freeze guard sensor is set
data_description.pid_forecast_lookahead_min: How far ahead to read the hourly forecast (0 disables forecast blending)
data_description.pid_forecast_blend: Weight of the forecast vs. current outdoor temperature (0 = current only, 1 = forecast only)
data_description.pid_fallback_outdoor_cold: If the supply probe drops out, run at maximum power when it is this cold or colder outside
data_description.pid_fallback_outdoor_warm: If the supply probe drops out, run at minimum power when it is this warm or warmer outside (linear in between; thermostat demand still applies)

envelopes.title: Whatsminer Options: Price & Surplus
envelopes.description: Optionally limit maximum power by energy price and solar/battery surplus.

data_description.pid_price_high: At or above this price, power is held at the minimum
data_description.pid_price_low: At or below this price, the full power range is allowed
data_description.pid_surplus_deficit: At or below this surplus, power is held at the minimum
data_description.pid_surplus_full: At or above this surplus, the full power range is allowed

tuning.title: Whatsminer Options: Tuning & Throttling
tuning.description: Configure step bands, adjust intervals, integral band, ramp rate, and slope smoothing.

data_description.pid_min_power_step: Minimum power step when far from setpoint (coarse)
data_description.pid_min_power_step_medium: Minimum power step when moderately close to setpoint
data_description.pid_min_power_step_fine: Minimum power step when very close to setpoint (fine)
data_description.pid_coarse_step_band: Error threshold for coarse step (far from setpoint)
data_description.pid_fine_step_band: Error threshold for fine step (close to setpoint)
data_description.pid_integral_band: Error band for conditional integral freeze (0 disables)
data_description.pid_setpoint_ramp_rate: Max rate at which setpoint changes (0 disables ramping)
data_description.pid_slope_ewma_tau_s: EWMA time constant for supply-temp slope used to refine step size (0 disables)
